meta.title: Post Collection (Demo)
meta.description: Save articles from around the web, extract readable content, organize them into collections, and review them with notes in WordPress. Pre-loaded with two collections whose articles are fetched live from the web so you can explore right away.
meta.author: Alex Kirk

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if ( ! post_type_exists( 'collected_post' ) || ! class_exists( '\PostCollection\Post_Collection_App' ) ) {
	return;
}

$app = \PostCollection\Post_Collection_App::instance();
if ( ! $app ) {
	return;
}

$post_collection = $app->get_post_collection();

$owner    = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
$owner_id = $owner ? $owner->ID : 1;

// A saved article is authored by whoever saves it, and nobody is logged in while
// the blueprint runs, so the demo posts would otherwise have no author.
wp_set_current_user( $owner_id );

$collections = array(
	array(
		'name'  => 'Collected Posts',
		'slug'  => 'collected-posts',
		'mode'  => 'posts',
		'view'  => 'reader',
		'items' => array(
			array(
				'url'      => 'https://alex.kirk.at/2026/04/14/why-my-wordpress/',
				'fallback' => 'Why My WordPress?',
				'status'   => 'read',
				'rating'   => 5,
				'notes'    => 'Why a WordPress can be worth running for yourself rather than for an audience. Read it here, in the copy this site keeps.',
			),
		),
	),
	array(
		'name'  => 'Bookmarks',
		'slug'  => 'bookmarks',
		'mode'  => 'bookmarks',
		'view'  => 'links',
		'items' => array(
			array(
				'url'      => 'https://wpapps.kirk.at/',
				'fallback' => 'WP Apps',
			),
		),
	),
);

foreach ( $collections as $definition ) {
	$created = wp_insert_term(
		$definition['name'],
		\PostCollection\Post_Collection::COLLECTION_TAXONOMY,
		array(
			'slug' => $definition['slug'],
		)
	);

	if ( is_wp_error( $created ) ) {
		continue;
	}

	$collection = get_term( $created['term_id'], \PostCollection\Post_Collection::COLLECTION_TAXONOMY );
	if ( ! $collection || is_wp_error( $collection ) ) {
		continue;
	}

	update_term_meta( $collection->term_id, 'post_collection_frontend_mode', $definition['mode'] );
	update_term_meta( $collection->term_id, 'post_collection_frontend_view', $definition['view'] );
	update_term_meta( $collection->term_id, 'friends_publish_post_collection', true );

	foreach ( $definition['items'] as $item ) {
		// Fetch the page and extract the article text, exactly as saving a URL in the app does.
		$saved = $post_collection->import_item_to_collection( $collection, array( 'url' => $item['url'] ) );

		if ( is_wp_error( $saved ) ) {
			// The page could not be fetched: keep the link so the collection is not empty.
			$post_id = $post_collection->save_url_to_collection_term_without_content(
				$item['url'],
				$collection,
				array(
					'title' => $item['fallback'],
				)
			);
		} else {
			$post_id = (int) $saved['post_id'];
		}

		if ( ! $post_id || is_wp_error( $post_id ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( isset( $item['status'] ) ) {
			$post_collection->get_article_notes()->save_note(
				$post_id,
				$item['status'],
				isset( $item['rating'] ) ? $item['rating'] : null,
				isset( $item['notes'] ) ? $item['notes'] : null
			);
		}
	}
}
